summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude from gross income any gain from the sale of qualified real property interests to a qualified organization for purposes related to the Department of Defense's Readiness and Environmental Protection Integration (REPI) program.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude from gross income the gain from the sale of qualified real property interests for the REPI program. This exclusion would reduce the taxable income for individuals or entities making such sales, thereby lowering their tax liability.

The bill creates a new tax exclusion under IRC section 139J for capital gains on sales of qualified real property interests to qualified organizations for REPI program purposes. This is a targeted revenue-reducing tax expenditure whose direct effect is to forgo federal tax collections, thereby increasing the deficit to support military readiness and conservation priorities.
